dct_description_sm: 1. Provides public access to real-time instantatenous streamflow collected at over 1800 active locations in Canada. These data are collected under a national program jointly administered under federal-provincial and federal-territorial cost-sharing agreements; 2. Provides public access to archived daily streamflow for stations of interest using search criteria. These data include: daily and monthly mean, max and min of flow. For some sites, annual peaks and extremes are also recorded. Archived streamflow data are disseminated online; 3. Provides public access to a MS Access database file containing archived daily streamflow that users can download to their desktop. These data include: daily and monthly mean, max and min of flow. For some sites, annual peaks and extremes are also recorded. MS Access file is updated quarterly; 4. Provides public access to streamflow statistics for stations of interest using search criteria.
